request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English, used as a 'listen and find' game scene: the learner hears a sentence and taps the matching subject. Natural everyday photographic detail, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. Every subject named below must be instantly recognizable on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

FOUR FRONT DOORS photographed straight on from across a narrow street, so close that the four doors fill the whole width of the photo side by side in one continuous brick wall, with only a little brick between them. Each door is a different color: from left to right blue, green, red, yellow. On each door, at eye level, one BIG brass house number, as wide as half the door: from left to right 11, 12, 15 and 20. The digits are large, clear and correct and are the ONLY writing anywhere: no street sign, no name plates, no letters. Evening light. No people. This is ONE single continuous photograph taken with one camera from one position: NOT a collage, NOT a grid, NOT side-by-side panels, no seams or dividing lines.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-11-16; before tax, not an invoice.
